items.summary_en: Public Domain Ishi, the California Yahi man who was known as the “last wild Indian.” In 1911, a starving Native American man walked out of the wilderness near Oroville, California. He wouldn’t speak his own name, but anthropologists referred to him as Ishi. Ishi was seemingly the last surviving member of the Yahi tribe, a subgroup of the Yana people who once lived near the Sierra Nevada Mountains of California. Most of the Yahi had been killed by settlers in the 1860s in a series of massacres that only Ishi and a…
